description: Header file defining the PixelTransfer11 class responsible for buffer-to-texture and texture-to-buffer data transfers in Direct3D 11 within the ANGLE project. It includes method declarations, internal structures, and member variables related to pixel transfer operations.

classes.name: PixelTransfer11
